title: Cisco security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-058.110217: TT-CSIRT Advisory – Cisco Security Updates
leadParagraph: Cisco has released security updates to address vulnerabilities affecting multiple products. A remote attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.
contentHtml:
Cisco has released security updates to address vulnerabilities affecting multiple products. A remote attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.

Information on the products affected and how they can be fixed can be found on the Cisco Website via the following links:

a) Wireless LAN Controller 802.11v Basic Service Set Transition Management Denial of Service Vulnerability cisco-sa-20171101-wlc2

b) Wireless LAN Controller Simple Network Management Protocol Memory Leak Denial of Service Vulnerability cisco-sa-20171101-wlc1

c) Identity Services Engine Privilege Escalation Vulnerability cisco-sa-20171101-ise

d) Firepower 4100 Series NGFW and Firepower 9300 Security Appliance Smart Licensing Command Injection Vulnerability cisco-sa-20171101-fpwr

e) Prime Collaboration Provisioning Authenticated SQL Injection Vulnerability cisco-sa-20171101-cpcp

f) Application Policy Infrastructure Controller Enterprise Module Unauthorized Access Vulnerability cisco-sa-20171101-apicem

g) Aironet 1560, 2800, and 3800 Series Access Point Platforms Extensible Authentication Protocol Denial of Service Vulnerability cisco-sa-20171101-aironet2

h) Aironet 1560, 2800, and 3800 Series Access Point Platforms 802.11 Denial of Service Vulnerability cisco-sa-20171101-aironet1
